Reachable keeps the text of a hidden element and drops template content

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<p>visible</p><div role=\"tabpanel\" hidden>tab two body</div><template><p>row template</p></template>", new ConversionOptions { HiddenContent = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<HiddenContent>("\"Reachable\"", ConfigOptions)! });
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
